cues.en: Instructors: In this video, we are going to explore using the Z-score normalization for identifying and removing outliers.
cues.zh: 講師：這部影片會探索如何使用 Z 分數正規化來辨識並移除離群值。

cues.en: So let's begin.
cues.zh: 我們開始吧。

cues.en: We will create some data.
cues.zh: 先建立資料。

cues.en: I'm starting off by creating some data with normal distribution, and then these lines of code are basically just modifying the normal distribution.
cues.zh: 一開始建立常態分布資料，接著這幾行程式基本上是修改這個常態分布。

cues.en: The thing is that the normal distribution, if you just generate random numbers from a Gaussian distribution like this, you're not really likely to get a lot of outliers.
cues.zh: 問題是，如果只是像這樣從高斯分布產生隨機數，其實不太可能得到很多離群值。

cues.en: So one thing that I'm doing here is forcing some outliers.
cues.zh: 所以這裡做的一件事，就是強制製造一些離群值。

cues.en: So I say all of the data values that are greater than two, which we are not guaranteed to get, but fairly likely to get some data values greater than two,
cues.zh: 我把所有大於 2 的資料值，雖然不保證會有，但很可能會出現一些大於 2 的資料值，

cues.en: we take those data values and we square them.
cues.zh: 取出後平方。

cues.en: Again, the whole point here is just to give us some outliers, increase the probability of finding some outliers in the data.
cues.zh: 同樣地，目的只是製造一些離群值，增加在資料中找到離群值的機率。

cues.en: And then I'm also scaling and shifting the data.
cues.zh: 另外也將資料縮放和平移。

cues.en: And that's just for, you know, interesting comparison with the Z-normalization.
cues.zh: 只是為了和 Z 正規化做個有趣的比較。

cues.en: So we're gonna have our original data in a different scale.
cues.zh: 讓原始資料使用不同尺度。

cues.en: Okay, so we create the data, and we Z-normalize, here we specify a threshold.
cues.zh: 好，建立資料，再進行 Z 正規化，這裡指定門檻。

cues.en: So I'm saying that I'm going to consider an outlier or consider a data point to be an outlier, if it's associated Z-score
cues.zh: 如果某個資料點對應的 Z 分數

cues.en: is either greater than plus three or less than minus three.
cues.zh: 大於 +3，或小於 −3，我就會把它視為離群值。

cues.en: So if it's more extreme than three standard deviations, either way.
cues.zh: 也就是不管哪個方向，只要超過三個標準差。

cues.en: Okay, so let's start by doing some plotting.
cues.zh: 好，先畫圖。

cues.en: Here's the original data, here's the Z-score normalized data.
cues.zh: 這裡是原始資料，這裡是 Z 分數正規化後的資料。

cues.en: And it turned out unfortunately we don't have any outliers.
cues.zh: 可惜，結果沒有離群值。

cues.en: Typically, you would want to have a dataset that doesn't have outliers, but in this particular case, I'm actually disappointed that we don't have outliers.
cues.zh: 通常會希望資料集沒有離群值，但這個特定情況下，我反而失望沒有離群值。

cues.en: So run it again.
cues.zh: 所以再執行一次。

cues.en: Aha, there we go.
cues.zh: 啊，有了。

cues.en: Now we get one large value here, Aactually it looks like two, fairly large values here.
cues.zh: 這裡出現一個很大的值，其實看起來有兩個相當大的值。

cues.en: It's unclear whether this would be an outlier.
cues.zh: 這個算不算離群值，不太明確。

cues.en: According to our threshold, this is not an outlier.
cues.zh: 根據我們的門檻，這不是離群值。

cues.en: If you change the threshold, then this could be identified as an outlier.
cues.zh: 如果改變門檻，就可能被辨識為離群值。

cues.en: So one more illustration of the kind of, little bit subjectivity or arbitrariness of these kinds of thresholds, okay?
cues.zh: 這再次說明，這類門檻有一點主觀性或任意性，好嗎？

cues.en: But certainly we have at least one outlier here.
cues.zh: 但這裡確實至少有一個離群值。

cues.en: Alright, so now what I do is find the outliers.
cues.zh: 好，現在找出離群值。

cues.en: So what I do is say the data Z-scored and then I take the absolute value, so I'm flipping the minus signs here, and that's because I want to find data values
cues.zh: 取 Z 分數資料的絕對值，也就是把負號翻過來，因為要找出

cues.en: that are more extreme than the threshold.
cues.zh: 超過門檻、比較極端的資料值。

cues.en: Either way, they can be more extreme on the high end or more extreme on the low end.
cues.zh: 不管哪一側，可以是高值端，也可以是低值端。

cues.en: So that's going to give us, and we already know from looking at this graph that that's going to give us one value and it happens to be data point 22.
cues.zh: 這樣就會得到，從圖上我們已經知道只會得到一個值，剛好是第 22 個資料點。

cues.en: Okay, and then I'm just going to draw them on the plot here.
cues.zh: 好，接著在圖上把它們畫出來。

cues.en: So you can see I'm crossing these out.
cues.zh: 可以看到，我用叉號標記它們。

cues.en: So this is just a line of code for identifying the outliers.
cues.zh: 這行程式只是用來辨識離群值。

cues.en: And then what you do with this outlier depends on how you're setting up the data, what other analyses you're doing and so on.
cues.zh: 接著怎麼處理這個離群值，取決於資料如何設定、還要做哪些其他分析等等。

cues.en: Maybe you want to completely remove this data point from the data and then you'd end up with 39 data points instead of 40.
cues.zh: 也許要完全移除這個資料點，這樣就剩下 39 個，而不是 40 個資料點。

cues.en: Or maybe you want to replace this with an NaN for example.
cues.zh: 或者可以將它換成 NaN。

cues.en: So then you still have 40 data points, but one of them is an NaN, so it gets excluded from the analyses.
cues.zh: 這樣仍然有 40 個資料點，但其中一個是 NaN，所以分析時會排除它。

cues.en: Alright, so this is for the one shot Z-normalization procedure for identifying outliers.
cues.zh: 好，這是使用單次 Z 正規化程序來辨識離群值。

cues.en: What I'm illustrating to you here is the iterative method that I discussed in the video.
cues.zh: 這裡要示範的，是影片中討論的迭代方法。

cues.en: Now notice again, I'm lowering the Z-score threshold, previously it was three and now I'm setting it to be two.
cues.zh: 再次注意，我降低了 Z 分數門檻，之前是 3，現在設為 2。

cues.en: So in fact, this one's also gonna be identified as an outlier, as I mentioned in the previous video, I'll say it again here because it's important.
cues.zh: 因此，這個也會被辨識為離群值。前一部影片提過，但因為很重要，這裡再說一次。

cues.en: I don't recommend normally lowering your Z-score threshold to two, that's a little bit too liberal, only doing it here for illustration,
cues.zh: 通常不建議把 Z 分數門檻降到 2，這有點太寬鬆；這裡只是為了示範，

cues.en: just because it's more likely to give us more than one loop, more than one iteration, although I doubt that's gonna happen this time.
cues.zh: 因為這樣比較容易產生超過一輪、超過一次迭代，但這次我懷疑會不會發生。

cues.en: I think when we remove these two data points, these will all be within two standard deviations of their mean.
cues.zh: 我想移除這兩個資料點後，其他點都會落在其平均值的兩個標準差之內。

cues.en: Okay, so I'm doing this in a while loop, and we want to use a while loop here instead of a for loop.
cues.zh: 好，這裡使用 while 迴圈，而不是 for 迴圈。

cues.en: And that's because you would use a for loop when you know in advance how many iterations you're gonna go through, which is actually not the case here.
cues.zh: 因為事先知道要迭代幾次時，才會使用 for 迴圈，但這裡不是。

cues.en: We don't know how many iterations we're gonna need to clean the data.
cues.zh: 我們不知道需要幾次迭代才能清理資料。

cues.en: So a while loop is useful for when you want to keep running through the data over and over again until you reach some criterion and I'll discuss what that is in a moment.
cues.zh: 所以想反覆處理資料，直到符合某個條件時，就適合使用 while 迴圈；等一下會談那個條件。

cues.en: Okay, so what are we doing in this while loop?
cues.zh: 那這個 while 迴圈做什麼？

cues.en: Well, first of all, the conditional on the while loop is true.
cues.zh: 首先，while 迴圈的條件是 true。

cues.en: So if, you know, if we didn't have this break statement here to break us out of the while loop and basically we'd get stuck inside this while loop basically forever, you know,
cues.zh: 所以，如果沒有這裡的 break 陳述式讓我們跳出，基本上就會永遠卡在這個 while 迴圈裡，

cues.en: until I turn off my computer or the sun explodes and vaporizes the earth, or I guess I could press Control + C in the command window and Quit.
cues.zh: 直到關閉電腦，或太陽爆炸把地球蒸發，或者也可以在命令視窗按 Ctrl+C 結束。

cues.en: But you know, one of those things will happen first.
cues.zh: 總之，其中一件事會先發生。

cues.en: Anyway, so what I do here is convert the data to Z-score and I'm using this omit NaN option here.
cues.zh: 這裡將資料轉換成 Z 分數，並使用 omitnan 選項。

cues.en: And that's because the data are gonna start having NaNs in them.
cues.zh: 因為資料裡會開始出現 NaN。

cues.en: That's how I'm treating the data.
cues.zh: 這就是我處理資料的方式。

cues.en: Rather than removing data points, I'm replacing outliers with NaN.
cues.zh: 不移除資料點，而是用 NaN 取代離群值。

cues.en: And the reason why I'm doing that here is because I want to be able to match up these data points.
cues.zh: 這麼做是因為想保留這些資料點的對應關係。

cues.en: So if I remove this data point from the data, then this data point here on the next iteration is actually gonna be over here
cues.zh: 如果把這個點移除，下一次迭代時，這個資料點實際上就會移到這裡，

cues.en: because the 40th data point becomes the 39th data point when you remove one of the data points.
cues.zh: 因為移除一個點後，第 40 個點就變成第 39 個點。

cues.en: So that can really get confusing if you have to align various datasets.
cues.zh: 如果需要對齊各組資料，就真的會變得很混亂。

cues.en: So that's why sometimes it's better to replace outliers with NaNs rather than removing them completely from the dataset.
cues.zh: 所以有時用 NaN 取代離群值，比完全從資料集中移除更好。

cues.en: Okay, so convert to Z, find the data values to remove.
cues.zh: 好，轉成 Z 分數，找出要移除的資料值。

cues.en: And I see now that this is actually one-sided.
cues.zh: 現在我看到，這裡其實是單側的。

cues.en: So I'm only removing the data values that are greater than the threshold.
cues.zh: 所以只會移除大於門檻的資料值。

cues.en: So in fact, if we had any negative outliers, which I know that we don't, because of the way that I simulated these data, but if we were to have negative outliers in this dataset,
cues.zh: 如果有負的離群值，雖然根據模擬方式，我知道這裡沒有，但假設這組資料中有負的離群值，

cues.en: then this would actually not capture them.
cues.zh: 這樣其實抓不到它們。

cues.en: So probably would be better to say abs dataZ, I think that's a little bit more appropriate here.
cues.zh: 所以應該改成 abs(dataZ)，我覺得這裡這樣比較適當。

cues.en: Okay, so these are the data points to remove.
cues.zh: 好，這些就是要移除的資料點。

cues.en: These are above the Z-score threshold.
cues.zh: 它們超過 Z 分數門檻。

cues.en: And then what I do here is say, if the total number of data points to remove is zero, that means we're not removing any data, then we break out of this while loop.
cues.zh: 接著，如果要移除的資料點總數為 0，就代表沒有要移除的資料，於是跳出 while 迴圈。

cues.en: And if not, so else, that means if there actually are data points to remove, then I'm gonna plot those data points
cues.zh: 否則，也就是 else，代表確實有資料點需要移除，那麼就把那些點畫出來，

cues.en: and I set those data values in the dataset to be NaN, okay?
cues.zh: 並把資料集中對應的數值設為 NaN，好嗎？

cues.en: And then I do some more plotting, update the legend and so on.
cues.zh: 接著再畫一些圖、更新圖例等等。

cues.en: So let's run this code.
cues.zh: 執行這段程式。

cues.en: And here we see we only get through one iteration because well, in the first iteration, knocked out these two outliers and then there were no more outliers in the second iteration.
cues.zh: 這裡只進行了一次迭代，因為第一次就排除了這兩個離群值，第二次便沒有離群值了。

cues.en: So if you like, you can run through this code again, you can generate more random data and see if you can produce more outliers.
cues.zh: 如果有興趣，可以再執行程式，產生更多隨機資料，看看是否能製造更多離群值。

cues.en: This is an interesting case actually.
cues.zh: 其實這個情況很有趣。

cues.en: Let's take a moment to run this code again.
cues.zh: 我們再花一點時間執行一次。

cues.en: So now this went through two iterations.
cues.zh: 現在經過了兩次迭代。

cues.en: The first iteration knocked out these three data points and then the second iteration knocked out this data point.
cues.zh: 第一次移除了這三個資料點，第二次又移除這個點。

cues.en: This data point happened to be, oh, look at it, it's 2.05.
cues.zh: 這個點剛好是，看看，2.05。

cues.en: So yeah, like I explained in the previous video, I wouldn't really consider this to be an actual outlier.
cues.zh: 所以，就像前一部影片說的，我其實不太會把它視為真正的離群值。

cues.en: I'm making this threshold intentionally too liberal, just to illustrate how this method works.
cues.zh: 這裡刻意把門檻設得太寬鬆，只是為了示範方法如何運作。

cues.en: Okay, so next I want to talk about the modified Z-transformation.
cues.zh: 好，接著談修正 Z 轉換。

cues.en: So this I introduced, actually this was the previous video, the regular Z-score stuff was two videos ago.
cues.zh: 這是前一部影片介紹的，而一般 Z 分數是前兩部影片的內容。

cues.en: So here we compute the median of the data, so we're working with the same dataset, and here I'm computing the median absolute deviation.
cues.zh: 這裡計算資料的中位數，使用相同資料集，再在這裡計算中位數絕對偏差。

cues.en: Now super important, you have to be really mindful of this when you are computing the median absolute deviation, you have to make sure to use the correct second input.
cues.zh: 非常重要，計算中位數絕對偏差時，務必注意第二個輸入必須正確。

cues.en: And I'm gonna open up this function file here so we can read the help text.
cues.zh: 我要開啟函式檔案，閱讀說明文字。

cues.en: So notice even the function name, says "Mean/mediam absolute deviation."
cues.zh: 注意，連函式名稱都寫著「平均／中位數絕對偏差」。

cues.en: And what I wanna highlight here is these two lines here.
cues.zh: 我要強調的是這兩行。

cues.en: So MAD (X,1), X is the dataset, computes Y.
cues.zh: mad(X,1)，其中 X 是資料集，會計算 Y。

cues.en: So that median absolute deviation based on the medians.
cues.zh: 也就是以中位數為基礎的中位數絕對偏差。

cues.en: And if you don't input a second, if you don't provide a second input or if the second input is zero, then it uses the means instead of the medians.
cues.zh: 如果沒有提供第二個輸入，或者第二個輸入為 0，就會使用平均值，而不是中位數。

cues.en: So you might remember back in the video about variance and standard deviation I introduced you to, the mean absolute difference
cues.zh: 你可能還記得，介紹變異數和標準差的影片中，我介紹過平均絕對差。

cues.en: that was the variant of the formula of variants, that looks like a standard deviation, except that it's based on absolute value differences,
cues.zh: 那是變異數公式的一種變形，看起來像標準差，但以絕對差值為基礎，

cues.en: instead of square differences.
cues.zh: 而不是平方差。

cues.en: So both to this function implements both, the mean absolute difference and the median absolute difference.
cues.zh: 所以這個函式兩種都能實作，包括平均絕對差和中位數絕對差。

cues.en: So you just have to be mindful that you're actually computing the median absolute difference.
cues.zh: 必須注意，你真正計算的是中位數絕對差。

cues.en: Okay, and then this is just the formula that I showed in the slides and this is where we get the number 0.6745 from.
cues.zh: 好，這就是投影片展示的公式，0.6745 這個數字就是從這裡來的。

cues.en: So it is the 75th percentile of the normal distribution.
cues.zh: 它是常態分布的第 75 百分位數。

cues.en: Alright, and then we can plot these data.
cues.zh: 接著可以畫出這些資料。

cues.en: And so this is showing the dataset that I just generated.
cues.zh: 這裡顯示剛剛產生的資料集。

cues.en: Here's the threshold.
cues.zh: 這裡是門檻。

cues.en: Apparently, I'm still using a threshold of two, which is yeah, two liberal, although even if I changed it to three, we'd still identify these data points.
cues.zh: 看來還在使用 2 的門檻，確實太寬鬆，不過即使改成 3，仍會辨識出這些資料點。

cues.en: And actually what I would like to do is show you, so I wanna run this again for, I'm gonna create this figure for actually, okay, close figure three
cues.zh: 其實我想展示的是，再執行一次，建立這個圖，先關閉 figure 3，

cues.en: and then I'm gonna run the median version, the modified Z version in figure three.
cues.zh: 然後在 figure 3 執行中位數版本，也就是修正 Z 版本。

cues.en: And so what you can see comparing, let me see, the X axes aren't the same here.
cues.zh: 比較時可以看到，等等，這裡的 X 軸並不相同。

cues.en: So this goes minus two to six.
cues.zh: 這裡從 −2 到 6。

cues.en: So I'm gonna change the y limit here, set gca, ylim, I want us to be able to compare
cues.zh: 所以我要修改 Y 軸範圍，使用 set、gca、ylim，讓我們可以

cues.en: directly the regular Z-score versus the median Z-score.
cues.zh: 直接比較一般 Z 分數和中位數 Z 分數。

cues.en: So that's these two.
cues.zh: 也就是這兩個。

cues.en: And let me also make sure that this is on the same y-axis scale.
cues.zh: 也要確保這個使用相同的 Y 軸尺度。

cues.en: Okay, so now, so this is the mean, the regular z-score, and this is the modified Z-score with medians.
cues.zh: 好，現在這是以平均值為基礎的一般 Z 分數，這是以中位數為基礎的修正 Z 分數。

cues.en: So you can see that they don't look identical.
cues.zh: 可以看到，兩者並不完全相同。

cues.en: We get slightly different results for these two methods, but both of these methods would indicate the same two data points as being outliers.
cues.zh: 兩種方法的結果稍有差異，但都會把相同的兩個資料點判為離群值。

cues.en: Now, the reason why they look pretty similar here is because we have a dataset that is roughly Gaussian distributed.
cues.zh: 這裡看起來很相似，是因為資料集大致呈高斯分布。

cues.en: We can also have a look at the histogram.
cues.zh: 也可以看看直方圖。

cues.en: So we can say histogram of the data.
cues.zh: 輸入 histogram(data)。

cues.en: And you can see it's not a perfect normal distribution, Maybe I'll do this with 15 bins.
cues.zh: 可以看到，不是完美常態分布。也許改用 15 個區間。

cues.en: It's not a perfect normal distribution, but it's kind of normal-ish.
cues.zh: 不是完美的常態分布，但有點像常態。

cues.en: We have a peak, a concentration of values towards the the center and then it goes down somewhat on both sides.
cues.zh: 有一個峰，數值集中在中央附近，再向兩側稍微下降。

cues.en: So the more similar your data distribution looks to a Gaussian, the more similar the modified Z-score will look like the regular Z-score.
cues.zh: 所以，資料分布越像高斯分布，修正 Z 分數就會越像一般 Z 分數。

cues.en: As I mentioned in the video, the Z-score method for identifying and removing outliers from your data is really common.
cues.zh: 影片中提過，使用 Z 分數來辨識並移除離群值非常常見。

cues.en: It's possibly the most common way of identifying outliers in your data.
cues.zh: 它可能是最常用的離群值辨識方法。

cues.en: So it's good to make sure that you are familiar with this code up here.
cues.zh: 所以應該確保自己熟悉上面這段程式。

cues.en: All right, so I'm going to show you how to implement the Z-score method for outlier detection and removal, which I discussed in, guess it was actually two videos ago,
cues.zh: 好，接下來會示範如何實作離群值偵測和移除的 Z 分數方法，應該是前兩部影片討論過的，

cues.en: and I'm also going to show you the modified Z-score that I showed you in the previous video.
cues.zh: 也會展示前一部影片介紹的修正 Z 分數。

cues.en: So here we're gonna create some data, and these are normally distributed, so Gaussian distributed data.
cues.zh: 先建立資料，這些是常態分布，也就是高斯分布的資料。

cues.en: Now the thing about having a relatively small number of normally distributed data is that you're unlikely to get a lot of outliers natively by default.
cues.zh: 常態分布資料的數量比較少時，通常不太可能自然產生很多離群值。

cues.en: So what I'm doing here with this code is just kind of forcing a couple of, or increasing the probability of having some outliers in the data.
cues.zh: 所以這段程式是在強制製造幾個，或者說提高資料中出現離群值的機率。

cues.en: And the way I do that is by saying that all the data points that are greater than two, if there are any, there are likely to be some, those data points are replaced by themselves, squared.
cues.zh: 方法是，將所有大於 2 的資料點，如果有的話，而很可能會有一些，換成它們自己的平方。

cues.en: So that just increases the chance of having some outliers.
cues.zh: 這只是提高出現離群值的機會。

cues.en: And then this code here is just to like stretch and scale the distribution a bit, just to make it a little bit more interesting to compare against the Z-normalization.
cues.zh: 這裡這段程式則稍微伸縮資料分布，讓它和 Z 正規化的比較有趣一點。

cues.en: Okay, so here I specify a Z-score threshold of three.
cues.zh: 好，這裡指定 Z 分數門檻為 3。

cues.en: So we're gonna say that any data values that have a Z-score that is more extreme than three, so more than three standard deviations away from the mean,
cues.zh: 也就是，任何 Z 分數比 3 更極端的資料值，即距離平均值超過三個標準差，

cues.en: we are going to consider those to be outliers.
cues.zh: 都會視為離群值。

cues.en: Okay, so here is what our randomly generated dataset looks like.
cues.zh: 好，這就是隨機產生的資料集。

cues.en: It's pretty obvious that there's one unusual value here.
cues.zh: 很明顯，這裡有一個不尋常的值。

cues.en: Here is our threshold, three.
cues.zh: 這是門檻 3。

cues.en: And so this would clearly be identified as an outlier.
cues.zh: 所以它顯然會被辨識為離群值。

cues.en: Now, I only drew this line here on the positive side, but typically for data, for many kinds of datasets, you also want to apply this threshold to the negative side.
cues.zh: 這條線只畫在正值側，但對很多種類的資料集，通常也應該對負值側套用這個門檻。

cues.en: Of course, that depends on the characteristics of your data, whether it it's even possible or sensible to have negative outliers, but something to be mindful of.
cues.zh: 當然，要看資料特性，負的離群值是否可能存在、是否有意義，但這是需要留意的事。

cues.en: Okay, so here we are going to find all of the outliers in the data.
cues.zh: 好，現在找出資料中所有離群值。

cues.en: So it's the any data point that has an absolute value of the Z normalization greater than our threshold.
cues.zh: 也就是任何 Z 正規化數值的絕對值大於門檻的資料點。

cues.en: So notice here I'm taking the absolute value, flipping the signs, the negative signs here.
cues.zh: 注意，這裡取絕對值，把負號翻轉。

cues.en: So that's a way of saying, the possibility of having outliers above the distribution and outliers below the distribution.
cues.zh: 這樣就能同時考慮分布上方和下方可能出現的離群值。

cues.en: Okay, and then we (indistinct), and then I'm just showing them with an X, the ones that are identified as outliers.
cues.zh: 接著我們……〔此處語音不清〕，再用 X 標出被辨識為離群值的點。

cues.en: So this is with the original data scale, this is with Z-normalization.
cues.zh: 這裡是原始資料尺度，這裡是 Z 正規化。

cues.en: Now, once you have identified these outliers, you basically have two options for how to deal with them in the data.
cues.zh: 辨識出離群值後，基本上有兩種處理方式。

cues.en: One option is just to remove them completely from the data.
cues.zh: 一種是完全從資料中移除。

cues.en: So just delete those data points from the dataset.
cues.zh: 直接把這些資料點從資料集刪除。

cues.en: Another option is to replace those data values with NaN or not a number.
cues.zh: 另一種是把這些數值換成 NaN，也就是非數值。

cues.en: There's no right or wrong, but it does happen often that or is often the case that replacing the data values with NaNs instead of removing them from the data
cues.zh: 沒有對錯，但經常會發現，比起移除資料，將數值換成 NaN

cues.en: is more convenient.
cues.zh: 更方便。

cues.en: And that's because you still have the same total number of data points.
cues.zh: 因為這樣資料點的總數仍然相同。

cues.en: And if you are aligning the data points with some other features in the data or in the visualization, then that might be important.
cues.zh: 如果需要將資料點和其他資料特徵或視覺化內容對齊，這可能很重要。

cues.en: So for example, if we remove this dataset or this data point from the dataset, then this data point here, which is data point number 40
cues.zh: 例如，如果把這組資料，或者這個資料點，從資料集移除，那這裡原本第 40 個資料點，

cues.en: in the new removed dataset, that actually becomes data point 39.
cues.zh: 在移除後的新資料集中，就變成第 39 個點。

cues.en: Again, whether that is important, depends on what you're doing with the data, but just something to keep in mind.
cues.zh: 這是否重要，要看如何使用資料，但值得記住。

cues.en: Okay, what I'm going to show you now is the iterative method where we are going to go through several iterations to identify whether particular data points
cues.zh: 好，現在要展示迭代方法，經過幾次迭代，辨識特定資料點

cues.en: are identified as outliers over different iterations, okay?
cues.zh: 是否會在不同迭代中被視為離群值。

cues.en: Again, I'm having a fairly lenient Z-score threshold.
cues.zh: 同樣地，這裡使用相當寬鬆的 Z 分數門檻。

cues.en: As I mentioned in the video, two videos ago, and also it's comment here, but it is important, so I wanna say, I wanna reiterate it again,
cues.zh: 前兩部影片提過，這裡註解也有寫，但很重要，所以還想再強調一次，

cues.en: at the risk of sounding a little bit redundant, I normally do not recommend having such a lenient threshold, a z-threshold of two, two standard deviations,
cues.zh: 即使聽起來有點重複，我通常不建議使用這麼寬鬆的門檻，也就是 Z 門檻為 2，距離平均值兩個標準差，

cues.en: above the mean, is I'm sure there are cases where that's an appropriate threshold, most of the time it's not appropriate.
cues.zh: 我相信某些情況下這是適當門檻，但大多數時候並不適當。

cues.en: It's too lenient for removing data.
cues.zh: 用來移除資料時太寬鬆了。

cues.en: This is really just for illustration.
cues.zh: 這裡真的只是為了示範。

cues.en: Although in this case, based on these data, it's still not, we're only gonna get through one iteration here because we just have one data point that's gonna be identified as an outlier.
cues.zh: 不過根據這組資料，應該仍只會進行一次迭代，因為只有一個點會被視為離群值。

cues.en: Nonetheless, just to quickly walk you through how this code works, I'm going through a while loop here.
cues.zh: 即使如此，還是快速說明程式如何運作，這裡使用 while 迴圈。

cues.en: And the reason why I'm using a while loop and not a for loop, is that a for loop you would use if you know in advance how many iterations you need to go through.
cues.zh: 使用 while 而不是 for，是因為事先知道需要多少次迭代時，才使用 for。

cues.en: And a while loop is what you use when you don't know how many iterations you're going to need.
cues.zh: 不知道需要多少次迭代時，就使用 while。

cues.en: So here I say while True, which means we're gonna be stuck inside this for loop, or this while loop, basically, you know, forever until human civilization collapses into barbary
cues.zh: 這裡寫 while True，表示會一直卡在這個 for，或者說 while 迴圈裡，基本上永遠如此，直到人類文明崩潰、回到野蠻狀態，

cues.en: and we run out of electricity or we get to this statement break.
cues.zh: 電力耗盡，或者執行到 break 陳述式。

cues.en: I guess there's another option too, which is I can just force quit the kernel.
cues.zh: 我想還有另一個選項，就是強制結束核心。

cues.en: But you know, it's not one of those things will happen.
cues.zh: 總之，這些事其中一個會發生。

cues.en: Okay, so here's what we do.
cues.zh: 好，做法如下。

cues.en: We convert the data to Z-score, and here I identify any of the data values that exceed the Z-score threshold.
cues.zh: 把資料轉換成 Z 分數，這裡找出任何超過 Z 分數門檻的資料值。

cues.en: Now, this is actually taking a one-sided thresholding.
cues.zh: 不過，這裡其實使用單側門檻。

cues.en: So this is only looking for positive values here.
cues.zh: 只會尋找正值。

cues.en: So I think what would probably be more appropriate is to say the absolute value of the Z-score data.
cues.zh: 所以我想，更適當的做法應該是取 Z 分數資料的絕對值。

cues.en: So this is going to identify data points that exceed our Z-score threshold on the positive side and also on the negative side.
cues.zh: 這樣就能同時辨識正值側和負值側超過門檻的資料點。

cues.en: Now if we don't identify any outliers, then this variable ends up being empty.
cues.zh: 如果沒有辨識出任何離群值，這個變數最後就是空的。

cues.en: And so the sum of this empty vector is going to be zero.
cues.zh: 而空向量的總和是 0。

cues.en: And that is the signal to break out of this while loop.
cues.zh: 這就是跳出 while 迴圈的訊號。

cues.en: If there actually are data points to remove, then we just update the plot.
cues.zh: 如果確實有資料點要移除，就更新圖形。

cues.en: And here you see, I'm not actually removing that data point from the dataset, I'm just converting it into NaN, okay?
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，我沒有真的從資料集中移除那個點，而是把它轉成 NaN，好嗎？

cues.en: And then a little bit more plotting and just make the data look a little bit nicer.
cues.zh: 再稍微畫一些圖，讓資料看起來漂亮一些。

cues.en: Okay, you don't have to worry about this warning message here.
cues.zh: 好，不用擔心這裡的警告訊息。

cues.en: You can see, oh, actually we did get through a couple of iterations.
cues.zh: 可以看到，喔，其實真的進行了好幾次迭代。

cues.en: I'm a little surprised.
cues.zh: 我有點驚訝。

cues.en: So the, well that's because the threshold was really lenient.
cues.zh: 這是因為門檻真的很寬鬆。

cues.en: So on the first iteration, we just knocked off this one data point and then we re Z-scored the data.
cues.zh: 第一次迭代只去掉這一個點，接著重新計算資料的 Z 分數。

cues.en: So we Z-scored the data again.
cues.zh: 所以再次進行 Z 分數轉換。

cues.en: And then it turned out that on that next iteration, which is the iteration number one, so the second iteration, we actually did get one more data point
cues.zh: 結果下一次迭代，也就是編號 1、實際上第二次迭代時，確實又找到一個資料點，

cues.en: that was super threshold that was above two standard deviations greater than the mean.
cues.zh: 超過門檻，高於平均值兩個標準差以上。

cues.en: And then we removed that data point, or NaN out that data point, computed the Z score again.
cues.zh: 再移除那個點，或把它設為 NaN，重新計算 Z 分數。

cues.en: And then there was yet another data point, there's a black triangle that's just sitting behind this red triangle here, and I guess that was just barely, barely enough
cues.zh: 然後又出現另一個點，有一個黑色三角形藏在這個紅色三角形後面，我想它只是勉強

cues.en: to get over the threshold and that ended up being nixed out.
cues.zh: 超過門檻，最後也被排除了。

cues.en: Again, you know, I'm now saying this, for like the 18th time or something, Z-score threshold of two is way too lenient, but you know, it just illustrates how this method works.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，我大概已經說第 18 次了，Z 分數門檻為 2 太寬鬆，但這裡只是展示方法的運作方式。

cues.en: Okay, and then these are just the data points that we remove.
cues.zh: 好，這些就是移除的資料點。

cues.en: So data 0.0, data index 32, and data index 36.
cues.zh: 也就是資料點 0、資料索引 32，以及資料索引 36。

cues.en: So that's for the regular Z-method and the iterative method for identifying outliers.
cues.zh: 這就是使用一般 Z 方法與迭代方法辨識離群值。

cues.en: Then what I want to do in this video, it's the last thing in this video, is show you how to implement the modified procedure,
cues.zh: 接著是這部影片最後要做的事，示範如何實作修正程序，

cues.en: sorry, the procedure modified for identifying outliers using the modified Z-score, which is based on the medians instead of the mean.
cues.zh: 抱歉，是使用修正 Z 分數來辨識離群值的程序，它以中位數取代平均值。

cues.en: So most of the important code is the same.
cues.zh: 大部分重要程式都相同。

cues.en: The only difference, as I explained in the previous video is that I'm converting the data to modified Z, instead of to a regular Z-score.
cues.zh: 唯一差別，如前一部影片解釋，是把資料轉成修正 Z 分數，而非一般 Z 分數。

cues.en: So here you see, I'm subtracting from the data, the median instead of the mean, and I'm dividing, instead of dividing by the standard deviation, I'm dividing by the median absolute difference here.
cues.zh: 可以看到，從資料減去的是中位數，而不是平均值；分母也不是標準差，而是這裡的中位數絕對差。

cues.en: And then here's this normalization factor of 0.6745, which I showed in the formula in the previous slide.
cues.zh: 這裡還有正規化因子 0.6745，就是前一張投影片公式中的數字。

cues.en: And again, as I mentioned, that comes from the 75th percentile of the normal distribution.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，它來自常態分布的第 75 百分位數。

cues.en: And that's what I'm implementing here. Okay?
cues.zh: 這裡實作的就是這個，好嗎？

cues.en: And then we plot this again and yeah, you see, well it looks pretty similar to the Z-score normalization that I showed all the way, up above.
cues.zh: 然後再畫圖，可以看到，和上面展示的 Z 分數正規化相當類似。

cues.en: And as a final reminder of what I mentioned in the previous video, when the data are roughly normally distributed, they don't have to be perfectly normally distributed,
cues.zh: 最後再提醒前一部影片提過的事：當資料大致呈常態分布，不必是完美的常態分布，

cues.en: but when the histogram of the data shows a peak, a central concentration somewhere in the middle and it declines on both sides,
cues.zh: 但只要資料直方圖在中間某處有一個峰、中央有資料集中，並向兩側下降，

cues.en: then the modified Z-score is basically going to be really similar to the regular Z-score.
cues.zh: 修正 Z 分數基本上就會和一般 Z 分數非常相似。

cues.en: And these two metrics will differ primarily when the distribution is strongly non-Gaussian and that's when you should prefer the median based
cues.zh: 這兩個量值主要會在分布嚴重偏離高斯時出現差異，這時應該優先使用以中位數為基礎的

cues.en: or modified Z-score over the regular Z-score.
cues.zh: 修正 Z 分數，而不是一般 Z 分數。
